profile.headline:
Code Craftsman | 
Staff Software Engineer | Runner 🏃
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer and Technical Lead, I specialize in building scalable, high-performance applications that drive real-world impact. From leading AI-powered mental health tools used in high-volume production environments to architecting cloud-based platforms for custom manufacturing, I bring a deep full-stack expertise across web, mobile, and 3D systems.

I thrive in fast-paced, cross-functional teams, balancing hands-on coding with technical leadership. My toolkit includes modern frameworks like React, Vue, and Flutter, along with backend experience in Node.js, Ruby on Rails, and Python. I’ve worked extensively with AWS, optimized relational database performance, and developed microservices and APIs that improve efficiency and user experience at scale.

I’m passionate about solving complex problems with clean, maintainable code—and mentoring others to do the same.

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Led a distributed engineering team across multiple time zones, coordinating development efforts and delivery timelines to consistently meet stakeholder expectations. 
• Drove technical direction and execution for web-based 3D visualization initiatives, balancing product requirements, performance, and scalability. 
• Collaborated cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and engineering leadership to prioritize roadmap initiatives and improve development velocity. 
• Mentored engineers through architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical problem solving in a fast-paced environment. 
• Helped establish engineering processes and communication practices that improved collaboration across remote teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a high-performance web-based 3D visualization platform using Three.js capable of rendering extremely large CAD models (4GB+) directly in the browser. 
• Built a scalable CAD conversion pipeline that transformed common CAD file formats into compressed, optimized glTF assets for efficient real-time rendering. 
• Optimized rendering performance, memory usage, and asset loading to support complex industrial-scale 3D models with smooth browser interaction. 
• Worked closely with engineering and product stakeholders to improve visualization workflows and overall user experience. 
• Contributed to modern frontend architecture and performance-focused engineering practices for enterprise visualization tooling.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented a finely-tuned Generative AI mental health coach that handled 140,000+ messages in its first quarter.
• Architected proactive AI outreach message system to increase user engagement.
• Decreased server latency by decreasing number of database queries, increasing efficiency of database table structure, and using asynchronous processing. Time of average server request decreased by 50%.
• Performed comprehensive testing and debugging to identify and resolve server side performance bottlenecks, ensuring the reliability, stability, and scalability of deployed applications.
• Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, design solutions, and integrate user feedback, ensuring alignment with project goals and timelines.
• Conducted thorough code reviews and provided constructive feedback to team members to maintain code quality and adherence to coding standards.
• Employed AWS services, including EC2 and S3, to deploy and manage applications in a scalable and cost-effective manner, ensuring high availability and performance.
• Spearheaded the development of high-performance mobile applications using Flutter, ensuring seamless cross-platform functionality and user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading a small team to develop a dynamic and customizable cloud based platform for high-end cabinetry manufacturers to receive and manage orders from their clients. Allows for manufacturers to collect all necessarily details to produce highly custom cabinets and furniture through a easy to use online order entry program.

Developed a microservice to process user provided JavaScript code quickly and securely in a Node.js environment. Increased speed of processing (per item) by 100%.

Using Vue, Three.js, and Blender, developed a dynamic 3D model rendering system.
